tei:div.tei:p: (1)༄༅/ zab mo dbu ma'i gtam bde gnyis gsal byed rtses bya ba bzhugs so/ (2)'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ zab mo'i don bzang bdud rtsi'i skyes/ brim mkhas rnam dpyod mig yangs mas/ blo gsal skye bo'i mdza' la bskur/ theg chen lus kyi zungs su longs/ rnam mkhyen lam mchog mdor bsdu na/ kun rdzob don dam sems gnyis las/ rnam kun 'dus zhes gyal bas gsungs/ de la dang po brjod par bya/ 'gro kun pha mar shes pa yis/ snying rje chen pos kun bslang nas/ 'gro kun sdug bsngal phra rags las/ skyobs nas mthar thug gtan bde ba/ rgyal pa'i layon tan stobs 'dod pa'o/ de'i rgyu snying rje chen po la/ yang yang gom pa brtan gyur na/ kru mchog nar bu'i srog zhu nyid/ 'dzin la mkha' ldig gnod med bzhin/ nyin mongs nyes pas de mi brdzi/ 'bras bu kun rdzob byang chub sems/ rnam pa gnyis te dang po ni/ rtobs sogs yon tan mnga' ba'i dpa'/ bde (3)gshigs rgyal ba'i 'bras bu mchog gzhan don thob 'dod smon pa de/ rnamakun mi 'bral 'dzin pa'o/ 'dis ni nyon mongs lcags khams stong/ yud kyis rgyal ba'i gser la bsgyur/ spang bya nyin mongs de dag gis/ byang chub sems nyon mi nus de/ lcags kyis rtsi 'gyur mi nus bzhin/ rgyal ba nyid kyi bka' rtsal te/ gnyis pa pha rol phyin drug la/ slob par 'dod pa'i dam bca'o/ rgyal sras spyod pa rgya mtsho las/ sbyor 'dod tsam gyi bsod nams ni/ nam mkha'i khams su mi shong na/ mi ldog pa yi sems kyis su/ dngos su spyod na smros ci 'tshal/ gnyis pa don dam byang chub sems/ mngon sum theg chen 'phags pas gzigs/ rjes dpag tshogs sbyor lam nas bsgom/ de yi mtshan nyid gang zhe na/ gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa/ mi 'gags gnas med 'gro 'ong bral/ gcig dang tha dad yod med las/ (4)rab tu 'das pa gang yin pa'o/ de nyid rtogs pa'i thabs nyid las/ rig pa dang ni man ngag go

'dir ni dang po brtan par bya/ 'di la dgag gzhi ngos 'dzin na/ gang zag dang ni chos bdag go rang rgyud phung po lngar brten nas/ 'jig lta'i zhen yul nga zhes bya/ de la 'dzin pa bdag 'dzin no/ phung po bden par grub pa yi/ zhen yul chos bdag de 'dzin pa/ chos kyi bdag 'dzin zhes bya'o/ 'di gnyis 'dzin stang dag gis dbye/ gdag gzhi phung po la sogs pa'i/ chos rnams yang dag du nyid na/ bdag gzhanas gnyis dang rgyu med las/ dben phyir nam mkha'i padmo bzhin/ khyad par bdag dang phung po ni/ mtshan nyid mi mthun phan tshun ngu/ gcig dang du ma 'gal 'gyur te/ gcig na phung po ci bzhin du/ bdag de skye 'jig du mar thal/ yang na phung po rtag par thal/ bdag de rtag par 'dod phyir ro/ tha dad du na bdag de ni/ dmigs par thal na de med phyir/ des (5)na rnam kun stong pa ni/ gang zag gyi ni bdag med 'dod/ bden pa'i chos zhig rgyu rkyen las/ skyes zhes 'dod 'di brtags pa bya/ rgyu rkyen bdag gzhan yod med las/ mi 'byung ngo bo bdag gcig na/ las dang byed po gcig tu 'gyur/ gzhan na thams cad las skyes 'gyur/ gzhan yin khyad par brjod mi nus/ yod rtag bya ba mdo phyir dang*/ med la nus med ri rwa bzhin/ gnyis min rgyu med rung min te/ bshad zin skyod 'bab mngon sum phyir/ 'bras bu yod dam med pa la/ rgyu ni dgos med nus med phyir rgyu ni 'thad par mi rung ngo/ du mas gcig bskyed mi rigs te/ gcig dang du ma rgya med 'gyur/ du mas du ma mi bskyed do/ rgyu tshogs 'bras bu gcig mi 'gyur/ gcig gi du ma bskyed pa min/ gcig bden rgyu ni mi srid phyir/ gcig gis gcig bskyed pa'ang min/ tshogs pa dgos med gcig bden med/ phyi nang chos kun bden med de/ (6)rten cing 'brol bar 'byung ba la/ stog ba nyid kyis khyab pa'i phyir/ de phyir chos rnams thams cadan ni/ gcig dang du ma bral ba'i phyir/

rang bzhin ma grub chu zla bzhin/ don lam pa yi tshad ma yis/ 'ga' yis gnas rnyed ma yin pa/ de ni mthun pa'i don lam mo/ so sor rang rig ye shes yul/ chos dbyings spros pa nyer zhi ba/ rnam grangs min pa'i don dam lags/ mngon sum mthod lam 'phags pas gzigs/ dus 'dir mthong spang kun brtags spangs/ gnyis pa nas bzung bdun pa'i bar/ sngar gyi rtogs pa gom pa las/ nyon sgrib dngos spang shes sgrib ni/ brgyud de nyams smad gnyen po skyes/ shes sgrib dang po spang gnyen po ni/ dag pa gsum gyi ye shes so/ rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam gyis/ bag chags sgrib spang rnam mkhyen gyi/ ye shes ji bzhin mngon du mdzad/ gzhan don kun rjob gzigs pa 'thad/ chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos dang*/ bden gnyis dbyer med gzigs (7)phyir dang*/ bag chags spangs phyir gzung 'dzin bral/ mkhyen gnyis rgya mtsho brnyes pa'i skus/ shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab can/ deng sang mkhas pa kha cig gis/ bdag lta'i zhin yul nga zhes dang*/ phung po rang mtshan grub pa yul/ 'dzin pa gnyis po 'dzin gnyis bzhed/ dgag gzhi bdag gnyis phra rags mdo/ de phyir bdag med gnyis po la/ phra rags mdo ces rab tu bzhed/ des na rig pa ye shes kyi/ 'gal zla dngos zhugs dug gsum gyi/ nang tshan gti mug zhes bya ba/ des na bden 'dzin nyen sgrib 'dod/ de la kun brtags blo bsgyur dang*/ lhan skyes blo ma bsgyur ba yis/ bdag 'dzin gyis bskyed nyon mongs de/ rim bzhin mthong spang sgom spang ngo*/ de yi phra ba shes sgrib ste/ de la mngon gyur lkog gyur gnyis/ rdzes thob gnyis rnang mngon gyur dang*/ gnyis rnang bskyed rgyu sa bon ni/ skog gyur gyi ni mtshan nyid 'dod/ shes sgrib (8)la yang lagur mi dbye/ bzhi ru dbye ste sa gsum gyi/ gnyen po bar chad mdo lam dang*/ rgyun mtha'i bar chad med lam gyi/ rim bzhin che 'bring chung ba la/

phra rags gnyis phye spang zhes gsungs/ mngon pa gnyis nas bshad pa yi/ bden bzhi mi rtag bcu drug sogs/ 'jig rten 'jig rten las 'gas pa'i/ lam du khas mi lan ces smra/ 'on kyang gang zag rdzas yod du/ lta ba'i nyon mongs mngon gyur spong*/ sa bon spang bar me bzhed do/ dpe na thog pa che chung ni/ chos dang gang zag rang mtshan du/ grub par 'dzin pa dpe bskyed pa'i/ nyon mongs spang ba'i gnyen po la/ bdag med gnyis po dgos zhes bzhed/ theg chen thabs dang bdag med gnyis/ rdzogs par bsgoms pa'i khyad par las/ rab tu 'phags pa'i khyad chos 'don/ de phyir shes sgrib spang ba la/ shes rab thabs dang 'brel dgos 'dod/ dman lam sngon du song ba la/ tshogs lam nas bzung bdun pa'i bar/ spang bya spang ba (9)med par bshad/ 'on kyang mnyam bzhag ye shes la/ goms pa nus ldan sgrub phyir dang*/ rjes thob tshogs gnyis zung 'brel la/ spyod nas 'gal rkyen bsal ba dang*/ mthun rkyed bsgrub cha yod mod kyi/ spang bya dngos su med pas na/ gnyen po bar chad med lam dang*/ rnam grol lam gyi tha snyad mdo/ de phyir ngo mtshar tshul bzang la/ spang bya med na 'gal rkyen ci/ blo dang ldan pas brtag par bya/ 'di'i tshul bden pa gnyis po la/ kun rdzob 'jig rten shes ngo la/ ltos nas ming rkyang btags yod do/ yul la rang mtshan mi 'dod do/ ming rkyang tsam rkaras bden mtha' khog yod pa'i gra yis mdo mtha'/sel/ chos kun rtogs pas bar btags las/ rang mtshan rang rgyud rang dbang sogs/ don mthun pas na khas mi len/ yang dag kun rdzob mi bzhed do/ yag dag bden grub don gcig zer/ 'on kyang stong (10)nyid ma rtogs pa'i/ 'jig rten shes ngo la ltod nas/ blo de gnod pa yod med dang*/ yul la'ang de yin de min gyis/ gnod pa yod dang med pa las/ kun rdzob kyi ni dbye ba byed/ tha snyad tshad ma 'khrul shes gnyis/ gzhi mthun 'dod de 'phags pa yi/

rjes thob 'khrul dang tshad mar mthun/ don dam la yang gnyis 'dod de/ snang dang bden stong tshogs ldan gyi/ ma yin dgag gi chos de ni/ mthun pa yi ni don dam mo/ snang ba bden pas bden pa yi/ mdo dgag rnams grangs min par bzhed/ 'di gnyis jibazhin 'jal ba yi/ blo la'ang de bzhin tha snyad byed/ yul can skad cig skye 'gag can/ de nyid 'bras dus sangs rgyas kyi/ ye shes gnas 'gyur skad cig mas/ shes bya bden pa gnyis po dag skad cig re res gzigs par 'dod/ de ltar deng dus thal 'gyur dang*/ sngon dus 'phags pa sangs bskyang dang*/ zla ba la sogs thal (11)'gyur gyi/ dgongs pa mthun nam 'gal lam dpyod/ kho bo rang rgyud pa dag gi kun rdzob rnam pa gnyis su 'jog 'di yi tha snyad yul nyid la/ rang mtshan yod dang mi bsru ba/ yang dag gyi ni kun rdzob 'dod/ mdo dang bsru ba log pa yi/ kun rdzob ru ni rab tu smra/ do mjal blo yang tha snyad la/ ma 'khrul pa yi shes par 'dod/ dpe na don byed nus pa la/ rang mtshan gyi ni brda sbyar te/ rtog go'i gzhung bzhin 'dod pa yin/ rtenacing 'bres 'byung zab mo'i tshul/ gzhung 'di'i brjod bya'i don yin na/ bden grub yod ces sus khas blang*/ dpe na rag mtshan bden grub gnyis/ gcig ces klan ka tshig tu bas/ don dam la yang gnyis 'dod do/ rnam grangs rnam grangs min pa'o/ dang po rjes thob khas len bcas/ chos rnams thams cad don dam du/ yod dang med ces tab brtag na/ rang rang ngo bos rnam par stong*/ (12)stog bzhin snang la snang bzhin stong*/ snang ba nyid kyi rtag mtha' sel/ gzugs brnyan chu zla sogs dang mtshungs/ stong pa nyid kyi chad mtha' sel/ stong pa nyid kyang snang bar sha/ snang ba nyid las log shig tu/ don lam yod par mi 'dod do/ don dam las ni log shig tu/ snang ba gzhun du mi brtag go/ zung 'jug rten 'brel mtha' dang bral/ 'di yang mthar thug don min te/

don dam blo las 'das phyir ro/ rnam grangs min pa'i don dam ni/ spros pa'i yul min chos kyi dbyings/ ji ltar sngar bzhin phyis de bzhin/ 'gyur ba med pa'i chos nyid ni/ sems kya rag bzhina'od gsal ba/ yongs grub 'dus ma byas pa'i chos/ kun tu 'od kyi rjes 'gro ba/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i lta ba yis/ gnyis blo'irgyu ba rab 'gags nas/ ji bzhin gzigs pa 'phags pa yi/ rang byung ye shes mi g.yo bas/ ma mthong chen po legs par mthong*/ kun rtog spros pa'i yul min (13)(14)phyir/ byis pa rtog ger ci cha yod/ rang rgyud don dam mthar thug dang*/ 'phags yul thal 'gyur dgongs pa gcig des na thal rang gnyis po ni/ gang zag rim dang cig char gyi/ lta ba bskyed pa'i tshul yin gyi/ gzhan du rigs pas drang ci yod/ dpe na gnyam bzhag ye shes dang*/ rjes thob sgyu ma'i snang tsam gyi/ bsod nams tshogs la rab 'bad na/ ma brtags gcig pu nyams dga' bar/ sa dang lam kun myung bgrod nas/ mthar thug rgyal ba'i go 'phang la*/ ring por mi thogs phyin par 'gyur/ mang du thos kyang gdol spyod mkhan/ ngag dbang dpal bzang 'bod pa des/ rang dang gzhan lugs shes pa'i phyir/ sa bon tsam du bstan nas so/// /
